messages:
Ivy (CS): Heads-up: NovaStore onboarding shows a 16% dip in "accepted" replies for checkout-assist over 36h. Renewal in 5 weeks. Proposing a cautious pilot: route low-risk intents to rdx-slim-int8 and keep payment/escalation flows on current model. Thoughts? :warning:
Noel (Eng): Saw traces. p95 spikes on long chats, cost uptick. Quick snapshot:
```
p50: 205ms
p95: 710ms
avg_tokens: 420
```
Noel (Eng): Ops plan: gradual ramp 1% -> 5% -> 12% with metric gates and immediate fallback. Will exclude any request tagged `escalation` or `payment`.
Jin (ML): Eval note: rdx-slim-int8 shows ~0.6% acceptability drop on Nova prompts; hallucination unchanged. Recommend: 1) Canary 3% for 48h; 2) nightly eval + 4 human spot checks/day; 3) prefix cache for templated prompts; 4) token cap fallback >800 tokens.
ops-bot: Pilot blueprint created: https://internal.redwood/pilots/novastore-compact (internal)
Noel (Eng): Draft routing (pseudo):
```
routing:
  - match: tag in ["payment","escalation"]
    target: rdx-standard-2
  - else:
    target: weighted(rdx-slim-int8:0.03, rdx-standard-2:0.97)
    fallback: rdx-standard-2
```
Ivy (CS): I'll send a short customer note explaining protections and rollback plan. Can someone write a 1-line blurb?
Jin (ML): Blurb: "We're running a small, monitored pilot that routes low-risk checkout requests to a compact quantized model to reduce latency variability and cost; critical/payment requests will stay on the current model and the pilot is auto-gated by nightly quality checks."
Ivy (CS): Owners: @Jin owns evals & spot-checks, @Noel owns routing & rollback automation, I own comms + renewal note. Deploy when ready and I'll schedule a 15m enablement with Nova ops. Thanks team :thumbsup:
